import requests, json, numpy as np, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(t):
    prot={};het={}
    for l in t.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            rn=l[17:20].strip();an=l[12:16].strip();ch=l[21]
            if l[16] not in (' ','A'):continue
            try: ri=int(l[22:26]);x=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
            except: continue
            if l.startswith("ATOM") and rn in AA3: prot.setdefault((ch,ri),{"rn":rn,"atoms":{}})["atoms"][an]=x
            elif rn!="HOH": het.setdefault((ch,ri,rn),{})[an]=x
    return prot,het
def kabsch(Q,P):
    qm,pm=Q.mean(0),P.mean(0);H=(Q-qm).T@(P-pm);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T));return Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T,qm,pm
def xf(V,R,qm,pm): return (V-qm)@R.T+pm
AAs="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
Btxt="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
MM=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in Btxt.strip().split("\n")],float);idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,-1) for c in s])
GAP=-8.0
def nw_lin(s1,s2):
    a=enc(s1);b=enc(s2);n,m=len(a),len(b)
    Sub=np.where((a[:,None]>=0)&(b[None,:]>=0),MM[np.clip(a,0,19)[:,None],np.clip(b,0,19)[None,:]],-1.0)
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9);Mm[0,:]=0.0;Mm[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*GAP;jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        cand=np.full(m+1,-1e9);cand[1:]=np.maximum(Mm[i-1,:-1]+Sub[i-1,:],Mm[i-1,1:]+GAP);cand[0]=Mm[i-1,0]+GAP
        Mm[i,:]=np.maximum.accumulate(cand-jj*GAP)+jj*GAP
    i,j=n,m;mp={}
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(Mm[i,j]-(Mm[i-1,j-1]+Sub[i-1,j-1]))<1e-6: mp[i]=(s2[j-1],j);i-=1;j-=1
        elif abs(Mm[i,j]-(Mm[i,j-1]+GAP))<1e-6: j-=1
        else: mp[i]=('-',None);i-=1
    while i>0: mp[i]=('-',None);i-=1
    return mp

AIM="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q04516.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

# ---------- A. per-ortholog classification of the 2'-position pocket ----------
t=requests.get("https://data.orthodb.org/current/fasta",params={"id":"22973at4891","species":4891},timeout=180).text
seqs={};cur=None
for l in t.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith(">"): cur=l[1:].split(" ",1)[0];seqs[cur]=""
    elif cur: seqs[cur]+=l.strip()
cls=collections.Counter(); pairs=collections.Counter()
for k,s in seqs.items():
    mp=nw_lin(AIM,s); a216,a244=mp[216][0],mp[244][0]
    pairs[(a216,a244)]+=1
    acid = (a216 in "DE") or (a244 in "DE")
    basic_or_st = (a244 in "STKR") and not acid
    cls["acidic in pocket (NADH-type)" if acid else ("Ser/Thr or basic at 244, no acid (NADPH-type)" if basic_or_st else "neither")]+=1
tot=sum(cls.values())
print("Per-ortholog 2'-position pocket class (n=%d):"%tot)
for k,v in cls.most_common(): print("   %-48s %3d  (%.0f%%)"%(k,v,100*v/tot))
print("\nmost common (216,244) pairs:", pairs.most_common(8))
print("S. cerevisiae AIM33 pair:", (AIM[215],AIM[243]))

# ---------- B. electrostatics of the face around the FAD isoalloxazine ----------
p1u,h1u=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1UMK.pdb",timeout=120).text)
afp,_=parse(requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q04516-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text)
ch=sorted(set(c for c,_ in p1u))[0]
rsl=sorted(r for c,r in p1u if c==ch); s1="".join(AA3[p1u[(ch,r)]["rn"]] for r in rsl)
mp=nw_lin(s1,AIM)   # 1UMK pos -> AIM33
use=[(rsl[i-1],mp[i][1]) for i in range(1,len(rsl)+1) if mp[i][1] and 'CA' in p1u[(ch,rsl[i-1])]["atoms"] and ('A',mp[i][1]) in afp]
P=np.array([p1u[(ch,a)]["atoms"]['CA'] for a,b in use]);Q=np.array([afp[('A',b)]["atoms"]['CA'] for a,b in use])
keep=np.ones(len(P),bool)
for _ in range(12):
    R,qm,pm=kabsch(Q[keep],P[keep]);d=np.linalg.norm(xf(Q,R,qm,pm)-P,axis=1);nk=d<3.5
    if nk.sum()<40 or (nk==keep).all(): break
    keep=nk
print("\n1UMK <- AIM33 model superposition: %d CA, RMSD %.2f A"%(keep.sum(),np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm(xf(Q[keep],R,qm,pm)-P[keep],axis=1)**2).mean())))
fad=[v for k,v in h1u.items() if k[2]=="FAD"][0]
iso=np.array([fad[a] for a in ("N5","N10","C7M","C8M","C6","C9") if a in fad]).mean(0)
CH={'D':-1,'E':-1,'K':1,'R':1,'H':0.1}
def face_charge(resdict, chain, transform=None, cut=14.0):
    tot=0; n=0; lst=[]
    for (c,ri),dd in resdict.items():
        if c!=chain: continue
        if 'CB' not in dd["atoms"] and 'CA' not in dd["atoms"]: continue
        v=dd["atoms"].get('CB',dd["atoms"]['CA'])
        if transform is not None: v=xf(v[None,:],*transform)[0]
        d=np.linalg.norm(v-iso)
        if d<cut:
            aa=AA3[dd["rn"]]; q=CH.get(aa,0); tot+=q; n+=1
            if q!=0: lst.append((aa+str(ri),round(float(d),1),q))
    return tot,n,sorted(lst,key=lambda x:x[1])
qh,nh,lh=face_charge(p1u,ch)
qa,na,la=face_charge(afp,'A',transform=(R,qm,pm))
print("\nNet formal charge of residues within 14 A of the FAD isoalloxazine (the b5-docking face):")
print("   human CYB5R3 (1UMK) : %+.1f over %d residues"%(qh,nh))
print("   AIM33 model         : %+.1f over %d residues"%(qa,na))
print("   CYB5R3 charged:", lh)
print("   AIM33   charged:", la)

fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6))
ks=[k for k,_ in cls.most_common()]; vs=[cls[k] for k in ks]
axs[0].barh(["acidic (D/E) present\n(NADH-type)","Ser/Thr or basic at 244,\nno acid (NADPH-type)","neither"][:len(ks)],
            [cls.get("acidic in pocket (NADH-type)",0),cls.get("Ser/Thr or basic at 244, no acid (NADPH-type)",0),cls.get("neither",0)],
            color=["#2b6cb0","#c53030","#a0aec0"])
axs[0].set_xlabel("fungal orthologs (n=186)"); axs[0].set_title("2'-position pocket electrostatics\nacross AIM33 orthologs")
names=["human CYB5R3\n(1UMK)","AIM33 model\n(superposed)"]
axs[1].bar(names,[qh,qa],color=["#2b6cb0","#dd6b20"])
axs[1].axhline(0,color="k",lw=.8); axs[1].set_ylabel("net formal charge within 14 A of FAD isoalloxazine")
axs[1].set_title("Charge of the putative cytochrome b5 docking face")
for i,v in enumerate([qh,qa]): axs[1].text(i,v+0.15*np.sign(v or 1),"%+.1f"%v,ha="center")
